modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

plans.name: Nakama on Heroic Cloud (production)
plans.note: Calculator: $400 x Nakama CPUs + $200 x database CPUs per month (default 1+1 = $600). Satori on Heroic Cloud starts from $600/month (event-based ingestion pricing, bespoke above). Development instances (burstable CPU, micro DB, CI) exist but their price is not published. Billing: usage metered daily at the day's highest CPU count, prorated, invoiced monthly via Stripe; deployments cannot be paused, charges stop the day after deletion. Support: Studio Basic $2,000, Studio Standard $6,000, Studio Premium contact (optional, on top).

plans.name: Satori on Heroic Cloud
plans.note: LiveOps product, event-based ingestion pricing, 'starts from' $600/month; bespoke above.

caveats: Public managed multiplayer app backend supporting developer server modules. Rendered default Nakama calculator $600/mo includes database and managed platform; no 4/8-only price guaranteed. Support $2000/$6000 optional, not mandatory compute plans. Dedicated/HA/BYOC changes price.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

snapshot_auto.quote: Deployments can't be paused, stopped, or temporarily disabled. A deployment is either provisioned or it isn't.
snapshot_auto.note: No stop/sleep lifecycle to snapshot on. Separate: automatic daily differential database backups on a rolling 7-day window (restore via Heroic Labs support), which are scheduled backups, not snapshot_auto.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Use Data Export to download a complete PostgreSQL snapshot of your deployment's database for backup, analysis, migration, or any other reason.
snapshot_on_demand.note: Only an on-demand PostgreSQL database export (download, pg_restore yourself); no machine/server snapshot and no booting new deployments from a snapshot. Managed Nakama game-backend PaaS, not a VM/sandbox.

guest_firewall.note: No shell/root on nodes: customer code is Nakama runtime modules (Go/TypeScript-JS/Lua) compiled by Builders into container images run by the platform; JS runs in Nakama's sandboxed JSVM.

secret_proxy.quote: Runtime variables are environment variables injected into your Nakama processes.
secret_proxy.note: Secrets are runtime secret variables (env) or secret configurations merged into Nakama config at startup; secret flag only limits who can read the value back in the dashboard.
